**Main Menu Reorganization:** - Reorganized by workflow categories: 3D, 2D, Materials, Avatar, Fabric, Production, Render, Connect, Close-set, and Plug-in. - Tool locations at the bottom of each menu adjusted accordingly. - **Menu Bar Enhancements:** - Mode menu highlights selected item in blue for clarity. - Terminology updated: "Density gram per square meter" renamed to "Weight GSM" per industry standards. - **Property Editor and Library Updates:** - Fabric preview and property editor updated to reflect Weight GSM terminology. - Fabric Creator and physical property sections revised for consistency. --- ## Closet Library Enhancements This section details improvements in the Closet library for better usability and integration. - **Favorite Workroom Filtering:** - Only user-designated favorite workrooms are shown in the Closet tab, reducing clutter.
